items.stem: Effective structured onboarding is best understood as:

options.text: A single day of paperwork and introductions
options.rationale: Compressing onboarding into one day leaves new hires unsupported.

options.text: A planned process over weeks that builds competence and belonging
options.rationale: Correct: good onboarding spans the first weeks and months, not one day.

options.text: Something only the new hire is responsible for
options.rationale: Onboarding is a shared responsibility of manager, HR and team.

options.text: Optional once the contract is signed
options.rationale: Onboarding is a key driver of retention and ramp-up, not optional.

items.explanation: Correct: good onboarding spans the first weeks and months, not one day.

items.stem: Under data-protection good practice, HR should keep personal employee data:

options.text: Forever, in case it is ever useful
options.rationale: Indefinite retention breaches data-minimisation and retention principles.

options.text: Only as long as there is a lawful, necessary reason, then securely dispose of it
options.rationale: Correct: data should be retained only as long as needed and then securely removed.
Personal data must be access-controlled, not open to everyone.
Storing employee data on uncontrolled personal devices is a serious risk.

items.explanation: Correct: data should be retained only as long as needed and then securely removed.

items.stem: Which TWO belong on a sound offboarding checklist? (Select TWO)

options.text: Revoke system and building access on the leaving date
options.rationale: Correct: timely access removal is a core security control.

options.text: Capture handover of knowledge and responsibilities
options.rationale: Correct: knowledge transfer prevents operational gaps after departure.

options.text: Delete the payroll record immediately with no retention
options.rationale: Some records must be retained for a lawful period after exit.

options.text: Skip the exit conversation to save time
options.rationale: Exit insight is valuable and should not be skipped.

items.explanation: Correct: timely access removal is a core security control.; Correct: knowledge transfer prevents operational gaps after departure.
